identity_rule: Use exact protected LuxSync artwork. Specialty variants must not be invented without a validated production requirement.

placements.minimum_clearspace_rule: at least 0.5x the rendered orb diameter around the mark
placements.background_rule: use an approved dark or neutral field with sufficient contrast; do not place over visually busy imagery
placements.specialty_status: full-color-placement-approved; fabrication-specific conversion pending vendor specs

placements.placement_rule: left-chest placement centered within the garment decoration zone
placements.size_rule: scale proportionally; final physical size must be confirmed against garment size and decoration method
placements.specialty_status: placement-approved; embroidery/screen-print artwork pending vendor specs

placements.placement_rule: centered on front or back decoration zone
placements.size_rule: preserve aspect ratio and clearspace; validate actual print width with the decorator
placements.specialty_status: placement-approved; screen-print/DTG artwork pending vendor specs

placements.size_rule: validate stitch area, minimum stroke/detail and thread behavior before converting the protected mark
placements.specialty_status: placement-approved; embroidery adaptation pending vendor stitch specifications

placements.placement_rule: single-side or centered wrap placement with clearspace
placements.size_rule: confirm printable wrap area with the selected vessel and decorator
placements.specialty_status: placement-approved; sublimation/UV/engraving artwork pending vendor specs

placements.placement_rule: use exact silhouette and preserve internal spacing
placements.size_rule: validate minimum cut detail and weedability with fabricator
placements.specialty_status: placement-approved; cut-line conversion pending fabricator constraints

placements.placement_rule: preserve protected silhouette; do not substitute typed initials
placements.size_rule: validate laser/etch minimum feature size and material response before conversion
placements.specialty_status: placement-approved; one-color production conversion pending process constraints

placements.placement_rule: use the protected mark as the identity source and keep foil treatment restrained
placements.size_rule: validate foil minimum line, trapping and stock compatibility with printer
placements.specialty_status: placement-approved; spot plate and actual metallic material selection pending printer specs

vendor_inputs_required_before_specialty_: required file format and color mode
vendor bleed, trapping, cut-line or registration requirements
